Orianna|mid.identity: Magic damage control mage who fights through her Ball. Command: Attack (Q) moves the Ball while dealing damage, Command: Dissonance (W) creates a pulse that speeds up allies and slows enemies, Command: Protect (E) sends the Ball to an ally (shield and damage along the way), and Command: Shockwave (R) pulls every enemy near the Ball toward it. Her attacks deal increasing magic damage (passive).
Orianna|mid.playstyle: Teamfight and zone-control mage. Orianna wins by placing the Ball on an ally who engages, then pulling several enemies in with her ultimate.
Orianna|mid.early_game: Poke with Q (Ball placed in front of you) and your attacks, farm safely. Keep E to protect yourself from an engage. The Ball creates a zone: control it to stop your opponent from walking forward.
Orianna|mid.level_1: Command: Attack (Q) first. Poke and farm.
Orianna|mid.level_2: Command: Dissonance (W). Q to place the Ball on your opponent, then W: damage and a slow.
Orianna|mid.level_3: Command: Protect (E). A shield on yourself or an ally: defense against assassins, or E on your ganking jungler for extra damage.
Orianna|mid.level_6: Command: Shockwave: pulls in enemies near the Ball. In teamfights, place the Ball on an ally who engages (E), then R when they land in the middle of the enemy team.
power_spikes: First completed item: poke and area damage.
Orianna|mid.lane_plan: Poke with Q, farm safely and keep E for defense. Push your wave and join your team on objectives: Orianna shines in grouped fights. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you come back quickly after pushing.
Orianna|mid.trading: Short trade: Q + attacks. Long trade: Q → W. Defense: E on yourself. In teamfights, engage with E on the ally who dives, then R. Give up on it against assassins who dive you (Locke, Qiyana, Irelia).
threats: Assassins who dive you (Locke, Qiyana, Irelia).
Aurelion Sol, who scales better than you.
mistakes: Placing the Ball far from you and no longer being able to protect yourself.
Casting your ultimate on a single target.
Staying in lane instead of joining grouped fights.

matchup_notes.Viktor: Poke him with the Ball and stay out of his Gravity Field.
matchup_notes.Syndra: She outpokes you: farm and keep E.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for her R engage.
matchup_notes.Locke: He bursts you: keep E and play under your tower.

Orianna|mid.mid_game: Join grouped fights and control objective areas with the Ball.
Orianna|mid.late_game: Ball on the ally who engages, R in the middle of several enemies. Stay behind your frontline.
Orianna|mid.behind: Farm and play for a decisive ultimate in teamfights.
Orianna|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the lane and turn teamfights with a Shockwave on several enemies.
Orianna|mid.final_tip: In teamfights, put the Ball on the ally who engages: your ultimate goes off where they land.
